newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Internet service providers to merge.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Internet service providers to merge.

text.p: BRUSSELS, July 25 (Reuteur) - Belgium Online and Planet and Partners (United Callers/Arcadis) said on Friday they were close to finalizing plans for a merger that will create one of Belgium's largest independent internet access providers.
Belgium Online, United Callers and Arcadis would operate under the name of United Callers.

Vincent Lobel of Flemish holding company Lessius, shareholders in Belgium Online, told Reuters the new company will provide Internet access for over 10,000 Belgians, becoming "one of Belgium's biggest players."
Belgium Online's other major shareholders include newspaper publishing group Uitgeversbedrifj Tijd.

It is the second major change in Belgium Online's structure since the company was launched last October as a vehicle for accessing and making secure transactions over the Internet. The original company ran into financial difficulties earlier this year and was restructured and relaunched in May.
Planet and Partners, already one of Belgium's largest providers operating under the name of United Callers, recently acquired rival internet access company Arcadis.
Planet and Partners is owned by management, investment company Partners & Venture and Dutch company Decalcom NV.
